nose.about: the front fairing hangs from its left end as the front wing is damaged: it turns about x through the pivot (its right end down) and droops about y

head.about: the head (neck, helmet, visor) turns about z through the pivot by turn times the steering (-1 to 1, left positive) and leans about x by lean times it

notes.arms_about: each arm turns about its shoulder so that its hand follows the steering wheel's turn (the hand turned about the steering axis through the pivot), stretched by the change in the shoulder-to-hand distance

steering.about: the steering wheel turns about the axis through the pivot by the front wheels' angle times ratio (a left turn, anticlockwise seen from the driver)

notes.wheels: side -1: the wheel turned 180 degrees about z, so its outer face (+y in 'wheel') is at -y; the wheel spins about its own y axis, and a front wheel turns about z with the steering
notes.frame: x forward, y left, z up, metres, the ground at z = 0; triangles anticlockwise seen from outside
